body_markdown:
Company News


November 9, 2026


# Our week in London


Last week, part of our team was in London.


A day at Legal Innovators UK, meetings with firms across the city, and a lot of good conversations.


Henrik Hansson, Benjamin Johansson and Karin Karsten. Legal Innovators UK, 4 November 2026, London.


Legal Innovators UK


## The agent-native computer, on stage.


Henrik’s talk, “The Agent-Native Computer: Next generation of agent collaboration”, asked the room to look again at something we usually take for granted: how a computer should be used.


It started many of the conversations that filled the rest of our day, about what an[agent-native computer](https://www.vesence.com/platform) means for legal work.


At the booth


## A full day of good questions.


Our booth was busy from the first coffee to the last demo. People came with real work in mind: their documents, their inboxes, the way their teams review.


Thank you to everyone who stopped by for a demo or a question. Missed us? You can[book a demo](https://www.vesence.com/demo) any time.


> “A week of good conversations,
> and a reason to come back.”


Across the city


## Firms large and small.


Between the sessions, we met customers and firms across London, from large international practices to smaller teams, and caught up with familiar and new faces.


Every meeting taught us a little more about how legal work is done here.


What we take with us


## Three things
we take home.


-


The UK is a big, exciting market.


Firms of every size are thinking about how AI fits their work. We want to spend more time here.


-


The questions are changing.


Less about features, more about how work changes when agents do most of it and people direct and review.


-


We want to come back soon.


We left with conversations to continue and plenty of reasons to return.


Thank you to everyone
we met in London.


We look forward to seeing you again. Would you like to meet us next time?Get in touch , we would love to hear from you.
